raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. doorlike structure in fence, wall, etc, a. ( gen ) pintu pagar: my backyard has a ~, kawasan belakang rumah saya berpintu pagar; b. ( of railway ) pagar (kereta api); c. ( of walled city ) pintu kota; d. ( of palace, temple ) pintu gerbang, gapura; e. ( of canal, dam ) pintu air; 2. numbered exit leading to aircraft, pintu: to board the aircraft from ~ 8, menaiki kapal terbang melalui pintu nombor 8; 3. mountain pass, genting; 4. total attendance at sporting events, jumlah penonton; 5. see GATE MONEY. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
